meaning.en: A one-time transaction with no thought of future dealings, often implying a take-the-money-and-run attitude.
meaning.zh: 只做一次、不考虑以后往来的交易，常指不讲信誉的短期行为。

examples.zh: 这家店专宰游客，做的是一锤子买卖。
examples.en: This shop fleeces tourists; it only does one-off deals.

examples.zh: 做生意不能只想着一锤子买卖，要留住回头客。
examples.en: In business you can't think only of one-off sales; you need repeat customers.

usage.en: Predicate or object; often 做一锤子买卖. Colloquial.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、宾语，常说“做一锤子买卖”，口语。

meaning.en: For a secondary thing to take the place of the main one.
meaning.zh: 客人的声音压过了主人，比喻次要的事物占据了主要的地位。

equivalents: let the tail wag the dog

examples.zh: 这件配饰太夸张，有点喧宾夺主。
examples.en: This accessory is so showy it overshadows the outfit.

examples.zh: 背景音乐太响，喧宾夺主了。
examples.en: The background music is so loud it drowns out everything else.

usage.en: Predicate. Common in comments on design, music or fashion.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用于评论设计、音乐、穿搭。

meaning.en: Illness often comes from what we eat and drink, so mind food hygiene.
meaning.zh: 疾病多因饮食不洁引起，提醒人们注意饮食卫生。

equivalents: mind what goes into your mouth

examples.zh: 病从口入，饭前一定要洗手。
examples.en: Illness comes in through the mouth, so always wash your hands before eating.

examples.zh: 夏天更要注意，病从口入，别吃不干净的东西。
examples.en: Be extra careful in summer: don't eat anything unclean.

usage.en: Usually a standalone warning, often paired with 祸从口出.
usage.zh: 常单独作提醒语，常与“祸从口出”对举。

meaning.en: Not understanding what is going on; vaguely unaware.
meaning.zh: 对事情不明白、糊里糊涂的样子。

examples.zh: 他懵懵懂懂地签了合同，根本没看条款。
examples.en: He signed the contract cluelessly, without reading the terms.

examples.zh: 那时我还小，对生死只是懵懵懂懂。
examples.en: I was young then and had only a vague idea of life and death.

usage.en: Adverbial or predicate. Colloquial.
usage.zh: 多作状语、谓语，口语。

natural: flowers in bloom and a full moon

meaning.en: A wish for a happy, perfect life, especially in marriage.
meaning.zh: 花儿正好，月亮正圆，比喻美好圆满的生活，多用于祝贺新婚。

examples.zh: 祝你们花好月圆，白头偕老。
examples.en: May your life together be blissful and may you grow old together.

examples.zh: 中秋佳节，愿大家花好月圆，阖家团圆。
examples.en: This Mid-Autumn Festival, may everyone enjoy happiness and a family reunion.

usage.en: Used as a blessing; often with 人长久 or in wedding and Mid-Autumn greetings.
usage.zh: 多用作祝福语，用于婚礼、中秋祝词。

natural: not know what is being said

meaning.en: Unable to make out what someone is saying because it is confused or rambling.
meaning.zh: 不知道说的是什么，形容说话或文章杂乱无章、含糊不清。

equivalents: not know what one is on about

examples.zh: 他的发言颠三倒四，让人不知所云。
examples.en: His speech was so jumbled that nobody knew what he was saying.

examples.zh: 这篇文章读完，我仍然不知所云。
examples.en: After reading the article I still had no idea what it was saying.

usage.en: Predicate or complement, often 令人/让人不知所云.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语，常说“让人不知所云”。

meaning.en: To whisper to each other privately.
meaning.zh: 凑在一起低声说话。

examples.zh: 上课时不要交头接耳。
examples.en: Don't whisper to each other in class.

examples.zh: 会场里大家交头接耳，议论纷纷。
examples.en: In the hall people whispered to one another, discussing the news.

usage.en: Predicate. Often about audiences or classrooms.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常指课堂、会场。

meaning.en: To force one's own views or wishes on other people.
meaning.zh: 把自己的意见、想法硬要别人接受。

examples.zh: 不要把自己的意愿强加于人。
examples.en: Don't impose your wishes on others.

examples.zh: 家长不应把期望强加于人，孩子也有自己的想法。
examples.en: Parents shouldn't impose their expectations; children have their own ideas.

usage.en: Predicate; often 把……强加于人.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“把……强加于人”。

natural: in high spirits like the spring breeze

meaning.en: To be in high spirits because of success.
meaning.zh: 形容事业顺利、心情愉快、神采飞扬。

examples.zh: 他新官上任，春风得意。
examples.en: Newly promoted, he was riding high.

examples.zh: 拿到offer后，她一脸春风得意。
examples.en: After getting the offer, she looked on top of the world.

story.en: Meng Jiao, after passing the exam: 'Spring breeze of success, my horse hoofs fly' (春风得意马蹄疾).
story.zh: 孟郊《登科后》：“春风得意马蹄疾，一日看尽长安花。”

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial; sometimes slightly teasing.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语，有时略带调侃。

natural: order people about with a look

meaning.en: To order people about arrogantly, with gestures and airs.
meaning.zh: 用下巴示意、用神气指使人，形容有权势者傲慢的样子。

examples.zh: 他对下属总是颐指气使。
examples.en: He is always bossy with his subordinates.

examples.zh: 那位颐指气使的经理，没有人喜欢。
examples.en: Nobody likes that domineering manager.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。

natural: think no one is one's equal

meaning.en: Extremely arrogant, considering oneself superior to everyone.
meaning.zh: 自以为在当代没有人比得上，形容极端狂妄自大。

examples.zh: 他年少成名，变得不可一世。
examples.en: Famous while young, he became insufferably arrogant.

examples.zh: 曾经不可一世的巨头，如今轰然倒下。
examples.en: The once all-powerful giant has now collapsed.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate.
usage.zh: 多作定语、谓语。

meaning.en: Marvellous to the point of seeming supernatural, or exaggerated to that degree.
meaning.zh: 神奇到了极点，也指说得过分玄乎。

examples.zh: 他的医术被传得神乎其神。
examples.en: His medical skill is talked up as almost miraculous.

examples.zh: 这项技术被吹得神乎其神，其实并不复杂。
examples.en: The technology is hyped as magic, but it isn't complicated.

usage.en: Predicate or complement, often 传/说得神乎其神.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语，常说“说得神乎其神”。

meaning.en: To contemplate the present while recalling the past.
meaning.zh: 面对现在，追忆过去，多含感慨。

examples.zh: 抚今追昔，他感慨万千。
examples.en: Comparing the present with the past, he was filled with emotion.

examples.zh: 重回母校，抚今追昔，恍如隔世。
examples.en: Back at my old school, reflecting on past and present, it felt like another life.

usage.en: Often sentence-initial in writing.
usage.zh: 多用于书面，常放句首。

natural: long sleeves make for good dancing

meaning.en: With resources or connections, one can accomplish a lot; also, to be socially adept.
meaning.zh: 袖子长，舞姿更好看，比喻有所凭借，事情就容易办成；也指善于交际、手腕灵活。

examples.zh: 他长袖善舞，在各界都有人脉。
examples.en: He is a smooth operator with contacts everywhere.

examples.zh: 资金雄厚，自然长袖善舞。
examples.en: With plenty of capital, naturally he can do well.

story.en: Han Feizi: 'Long sleeves are good for dancing, much money is good for trading' (长袖善舞，多钱善贾).
story.zh: 《韩非子·五蠹》：“鄙谚曰：‘长袖善舞，多钱善贾。’”

usage.en: Predicate; often 多钱善贾 follows in the full saying. Today sometimes a mild compliment about social skill.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，原句为“长袖善舞，多钱善贾”，今多指善于交际。

meaning.en: To be genuinely the same in outward behaviour as in inner thoughts.
meaning.zh: 外表和内心完全一致，言行一致，没有虚假。

equivalents: be the same inside and out

examples.zh: 他为人正直，表里如一。
examples.en: He is upright and genuine through and through.

examples.zh: 做人要表里如一，不能当面一套背后一套。
examples.en: Be consistent; don't say one thing to people's faces and another behind their backs.

usage.en: Predicate.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。

natural: eat next year's grain this year

meaning.en: To spend in advance what one will earn later; to live beyond one's means.
meaning.zh: 寅年吃了卯年的粮，比喻入不敷出，预支未来的收入。

examples.zh: 很多年轻人靠信用卡寅吃卯粮。
examples.en: Many young people live on credit cards, spending money they haven't yet earned.

examples.zh: 地方财政不能长期寅吃卯粮。
examples.en: Local finances can't run on borrowed money for long.

usage.en: Predicate.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。

meaning.en: Official business done by routine; or work done perfunctorily without real effort.
meaning.zh: 按惯例办理公事；也指只是照章办事、敷衍应付。

examples.zh: 今天的检查只是例行公事。
examples.en: Today's inspection is just routine.

examples.zh: 他处理投诉总是例行公事，不愿多管。
examples.en: He handles complaints perfunctorily, without wanting to get involved.

usage.en: Predicate or object; slightly disparaging when 'perfunctory'.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、宾语，表敷衍时略带贬义。

meaning.en: The coldest part of winter, around the twelfth lunar month.
meaning.zh: 指农历十二月前后最冷的时节。

examples.zh: 寒冬腊月，他还在工地上干活。
examples.en: In the depths of winter he was still working on the site.

examples.zh: 寒冬腊月里，一碗热汤格外暖心。
examples.en: In the dead of winter, a bowl of hot soup is especially comforting.

usage.en: Adverbial of time.
usage.zh: 多作时间状语。

natural: enjoy oneself in one's own way

meaning.en: To find happiness in one's own activities, regardless of others.
meaning.zh: 自己从中找到乐趣，感到满足快乐。

examples.zh: 退休后，他养花种菜，自得其乐。
examples.en: After retiring he grows flowers and vegetables, quite content.

examples.zh: 她一个人看书听歌，自得其乐。
examples.en: She reads and listens to music alone, perfectly happy.

usage.en: Predicate.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。

meaning.en: To be anxious for someone else's safety or outcome.
meaning.zh: 替别人担心，因紧张而手心出汗。

examples.zh: 看他走钢丝，大家都替他捏一把汗。
examples.en: Watching him walk the tightrope, everyone was on edge for him.

examples.zh: 比赛太惊险了，真让人捏一把汗。
examples.en: The match was so tense it had us on edge.

usage.en: Usually 为/替……捏一把汗, often with 了.
usage.zh: 常说“为/替……捏一把汗”。

meaning.en: Avoiding people or questions, or being evasive.
meaning.zh: 故意避开，不敢直接面对；也指说话含糊回避。

examples.zh: 他的眼神躲躲闪闪，好像在隐瞒什么。
examples.en: His eyes were shifty, as if he were hiding something.

examples.zh: 有话直说，别躲躲闪闪的。
examples.en: Say what you mean; don't be evasive.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial. Colloquial.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语，口语。

meaning.en: To look on calmly and without getting involved.
meaning.zh: 以冷静或冷淡的态度在一旁观看，不参与其中。

examples.zh: 同事遇到困难，他却冷眼旁观。
examples.en: When his colleague was in trouble, he just looked on coolly.

examples.zh: 我们不能对环境问题冷眼旁观。
examples.en: We cannot stand idly by on environmental problems.

usage.en: Predicate. Usually negative, but can mean calm, objective observation.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，多含贬义，也可指冷静客观地观察。

meaning.en: To suddenly become furious.
meaning.zh: 突然变了脸色，大发脾气。

examples.zh: 听到这话，他勃然大怒。
examples.en: Hearing this, he flew into a rage.

examples.zh: 老板勃然大怒，把文件摔在桌上。
examples.en: The boss exploded and slammed the file on the desk.

usage.en: Predicate.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。
